high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post, specifically from the account "artdessine." The post is labeled as "Sponsored" and features a gallery wall setup with various framed artworks. The wall is composed of several black-and-white abstract and geometric pieces, arranged in a visually appealing manner. Below the artwork, there is a dark wooden cabinet with a woven design on its doors. On top of the cabinet, there are a few decorative items: a textured spherical vase, a small yellow object that appears to be a candle holder or a decorative piece, and a closed green book.
